source.title: Qdrant API

authentication.admitted: Secured Qdrant Cloud or self-hosted deployment using the api-key header.
authentication.bearer_alternative: The official contract also documents bearer authentication; this pack uses one closed api-key connection contract.
authentication.unauthenticated_alternative: The official contract permits deployments without authentication, but the generated pack deliberately requires a secured connection.

source.documentary_posture: Every generated leaf points directly at the immutable raw OpenAPI document from the pinned official Qdrant repository commit. The root carries dependencies rather than a second composition.

exclusions.POST /collections/{collection_name}/shar: The official operation requires multipart/form-data file upload; the current REST composition cannot construct that multipart binary payload.
exclusions.POST /collections/{collection_name}/snap: The official operation requires multipart/form-data file upload; the current REST composition cannot construct that multipart binary payload.

contract_gaps.multipart_snapshot_uploads: Two official snapshot recovery operations require multipart/form-data file upload. They are excluded because the current REST composition cannot construct multipart binary payloads; URL-based recovery remains admitted for collection and shard snapshots.
contract_gaps.scroll_pagination: POST /collections/{collection_name}/points/scroll returns result.next_page_offset, but the next cursor belongs inside the exact raw JSON request body. The current paginator cannot mutate body_raw, so callers paginate explicitly and the pack claims no automatic paginator.
contract_gaps.exact_request_integers: Every admitted JSON body is sent as literal body_raw. This preserves uint64 point IDs and versions as JSON integer tokens instead of routing them through JavaScript Number.
contract_gaps.exact_response_integers: Every admitted application/json response uses unsafe_integers=string so uint64 IDs, versions, and operation IDs remain exact.
contract_gaps.dynamic_origin: Qdrant Cloud cluster URLs and self-hosted origins vary. The connection is per-org and uses an HTTPS placeholder solely as an enrollment example.
contract_gaps.authentication_choice: The official security alternatives are api-key, bearer, and unauthenticated. The pack chooses the documented api-key header and does not weaken the connection to unauthenticated access.
contract_gaps.request_body_requiredness: The official OpenAPI marks every requestBody optional, including operations whose body schema contains required fields. The generated operation keeps body_raw optional to remain documentary; Qdrant remains authoritative when a call omits or supplies an incomplete body.
contract_gaps.arbitrary_records: Qdrant collections, points, payloads, vectors, and snapshots are datastore records rather than canonical work entities. No task, note, or project Source is declared.

source_eligibility.evidence: A Qdrant collection is a vector index, not a canonical project entity, and the suite has no live field-path proof for a project mapping.
Point payloads are user-defined datastore records; the pack does not infer task semantics from arbitrary payload keys.
Point payloads and vectors do not establish the canonical note fields or live load-bearing paths required by the authoring guide.
